# FM define-agent surface rebuild: AgentConfigCard + FleetSettingsPanel to the cockpit design SSOT (Lane D1 UX)

## Context

Operator verdict on record (2026-07-16): the agents setup view "does not match the design specs in any way," and FM is "not functional yet, not even close" — design and UX are early priorities. This is the anchor leaf of the design-conformance + functionality wave for cornerstone 1 (v13.2).

The design SSOT is `apps/agentos/design/fleet-manager-cockpit-plan.html` (committed via neomjs/neo#14512; @neo-opus-grace holds design authority on it). Its opening line defines this ticket's target by antithesis: *"Mission control for a cross-model AI engineering team — **not a settings form**."*

## The Problem

The define-agent surface IS that settings form. It is the pre-design-sprint v0, functionally patched but never design-rebuilt:

- `apps/agentos/view/AgentConfigCard.mjs` (219 lines), `apps/agentos/view/FleetSettingsPanel.mjs` (188 lines), `apps/agentos/view/Accounts.mjs` (609 lines) import **zero** fleet design primitives — no token layer, no `fm-*` classes, no StateDot / HealthSwatch / FamilyRail. Their last commits were data-plumbing only (#14998 sparse-config persistence, neomjs/neo#14920 store de-singletonization).
- The design sprint (D#14561 T-leaves) rebuilt `view/fleet/**` to the SSOT bar; the setup/admin surfaces were out of its slice and still carry the pre-sprint look the operator already ruled "uber brittle" (2026-07-04, on neomjs/neo#14577's record).
- SSOT Lane D1 states the functional half plainly: "Add-agent flow — username + PAT + harness type → the Node-side registry (#13031 exists); **the UX for it does not**."

## The Architectural Reality

- The Brain-side machinery is shipped: registry + credential store (#13031), control-plane facade (#13192), add-agent canonical readback round-trip (#14614). This leaf is UI composition, not new services.
- The design system to compose FROM exists: token layer (#14578, `TOKENS.md`), AgentCard + card contract (#14598, `CARD-CONTRACT.md`), state/health/family primitives (#14593/#14635/#14637), both themes (#14681).
- Credential boundary per neomjs/neo#13058's matrix is non-negotiable: PAT/credential material never in browser persistent state, logs, URL, or visible echo; secret submission disabled when the Node-side bridge is absent; no fake success states (lifecycle-affordance rule).
- `apps/**` gate applies: data-carrying UI binds `data.Store` of `data.Model` records; `state.Provider` at view roots; zero CSS-in-JS (SCSS token/skin layers only).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The define/add-agent surface is rebuilt from the fleet design primitives + token layer (light AND dark), replacing the form-generator look; `AgentConfigCard` / `FleetSettingsPanel` are each either rebuilt to the SSOT bar or retired and replaced under the cockpit shell — no second brittle surface left mounted.
- [ ] The D1 flow works on the REAL surface: username + PAT + harness type → registry round-trip consuming neomjs/neo#14614's canonical readback, with honest pending/degraded/failure states (no fake success; gated when the bridge is absent).
- [ ] Credential boundary evidenced per neomjs/neo#13058's matrix: test or audit proving no localStorage / sessionStorage / URL / log echo on submit.
- [ ] Design sign-off by @neo-opus-grace (SSOT authority) on the shape before merge; cross-family review as usual.
- [ ] NL-driven e2e witness of the add-agent journey on the rebuilt surface.

## Out of Scope

The Accounts keeper-view / credential-management rebuild (D2-adjacent — its own wave leaf; neomjs/neo#13521 context folds there) · live-wiring the cockpit stores off JSON seeds (C-lane wave) · wake/rate-limit telltales (#14537-adjacent) · catch-up view (#14620) · the drill regression (#15212, independent).

## Related

Epic neomjs/neo-agent-institution#10 (parent) · design SSOT via neomjs/neo#14512 · neomjs/neo#13058 (the v0 this replaces) · neomjs/neo#14614 (readback consumed) · neomjs/neo#13521 (adjacent, @neo-opus-vega) · neomjs/neo#14577 (target-app decision + "uber brittle" verdict) · operator directive 2026-07-16 (design/UX first; ≥50-ticket wave).

- 2026-07-18T08:19:28Z @neo-opus-vega cross-referenced by PR #15445
- 2026-07-18T08:23:54Z @neo-opus-vega referenced in commit `049ad02` - "fix(agentos): one staleness authority gates every outcome path — a stale response claims nothing (#15242)

Euclid's cycle-2 falsifier at 80e6bb279e: after an identity-move (reload replaces record A
with B mid-flight), a stale response's REJECTION or transport throw still painted its
terminal status over the newer owner's accepted truth — the old isSuperseded(A, gen) cannot
see B's newer generation, and the record!==arbiter guard lived only inside the accepted
branch. The record was protected; the status claim was not.

The module-level predicate becomes a per-call responseIsStale() closure consulted by EVERY
outcome path (accepted, rejected, thrown) before any write OR repaint: stale when a newer
intent bumped my instance's generation, or when the instance was replaced mid-flight and a
newer intent already targets the replacement. The accepted branch keeps its inner guard for
the recordless-issue edge (arbiter null, record materialized during the flight).

Two new witnesses: identity-move stale REJECTION and identity-move stale THROW — both may
claim nothing (record native-neo, older sink stays [pending] only). 360/360 agentos unit."
- 2026-07-18T08:41:31Z @neo-opus-vega referenced in commit `d928ac6` - "fix(agentos): the losing surface unlatches, the boot list respects any owner's write, the zone scrolls (#15242)

Euclid's cycle-2 addendum, all three:

(a) A response superseded by ANOTHER owner now paints its own sink 'superseded' — a
non-terminal, NON-LATCHING state (the card latches on pending only), so the losing surface
is told what happened and stays correctable; permanently-latched-at-pending was a dead
affordance. A response superseded by its OWN owner stays silent — the newer request owns
that sink's next paint, and a 'superseded' stamp over it would mislabel an in-flight save.
The record authority carries {generation, owner} to tell the two apart. Witnesses: the
two-owner overlap now proves told-and-recovers (re-entry round-trip), the same-owner case
proves silence, both identity-move drops paint honestly.

(b) The runner owns a per-store accepted-WRITE generation beside the per-record intent
ordering: every accepted readback bumps it, and Accounts' boot-list hydration captures it
before the bridge read — a list snapshot older than ANY owner's accepted write is discarded
whole. The owner-local onAcceptedReadback hook is retired; the runner takes the store
directly (getRecord derived from it anyway). Witness: a Detail-owner accept mid-flight
invalidates the older list; nothing regresses.

(c) The add-agent form scrolls inside whatever height its zone pane grants (min-height 0 +
overflow-y auto): on short viewports or wider platform font metrics the submit button was
below a non-scrolling fold — visible, enabled, unreachable. The journey pins 1280x720 (the
falsifier environment) so the witness holds where geometry is tight, not only on tall local
screens. Theme guard: parity + token-only + completeness pass.

363/363 agentos unit · 20/20 agentos e2e at the pinned viewport."
